steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test company configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publication.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add a QA vendor so the event can be published.
